test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the pair that is NOT matched correctly (the dam of the river it is built on).
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nathpa Jakri Dam-Jhelum river**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nathpa Jakri Dam** is built on the **Sutlej river**, not the Jhelum river.
 
• The **Nagarjuna Sagar Dam** is correctly matched with the **Krishna river**.
 
• The **Tehri Dam** is correctly matched with the **Bhagirathi river**.
 
• The **Indira Sagar Dam** is correctly matched with the **Narmada river**.
 
• It is important to know the correct pairings of dams and rivers as they are significant for geography and general knowledge.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Nathpa Jakri Dam** is the largest hydroelectric project in India.
 
• The **Nagarjuna Sagar Dam** is one of the world's largest and tallest Masonry dams.
 
• The **Tehri Dam** is the tallest dam in India and one of the tallest in the world.
 
• The **Indira Sagar Dam** has the largest reservoir in India.
